translations.web: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
translations.bsb: He is the One who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
translations.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
translations.asv: even he that cometh after me, the latchet of whose shoe I am not worthy to unloose.
